result.competitor: No CBI-agent compliance or case-management product was found. The CBIU has run an online portal for agents to submit applications since at least 2020; it handles submission, not the agent's own compliance tracking. Adjacent generic tools: CRMtravel visa management (agent hierarchies, commissions), Zoho CRM for immigration, CaseEasy (Canada), Oracle Siebel. Generic KYC screening tools such as World-Check cover screening only. A CBI firm's job ad mentions Salesforce, which suggests large agents use general CRMs.
result.duty: Under the CBI Regulations (as amended by SRO 8 of 2024), Cabinet-licensed authorised agents pay a US$20,000 initial fee and US$15,500 a year. They must be citizens, keep an office with at least 3 local staff, and are accountable for their sub-agents' and promoters' marketing and fees. Applications can be filed only through agents. Detailed record-keeping and due-diligence duties in SRO 8 are unverified because the PDF text could not be extracted. ECCIRA is enacted in all 5 states (Dominica on 14 Oct 2025), licenses agents, due diligence providers and escrow agents, and can fine up to US$250k or revoke licences. NTL said it was not operational as of 8 Aug 2026, and IMI Daily expected a September launch; the go-live date and periodic reporting duties are unconfirmed. The grandfathering claim (files before 30 Jun 2026) was not found.
result.market: Not found. The CBIU FAQ page that hosts the official authorised-agent list returned empty. IMI Daily quarterly trackers report roster changes but gave no Dominica total in the snippets I saw. The local market is likely a few dozen firms (estimate, unverified). The regional ECCIRA extension (5 states, plus due diligence and escrow licensees) is perhaps low hundreds, also unverified.
result.reason: The duty is real. Under the Dominica CBI regulations, agents must be licensed by Cabinet, pay US$20,000 up front and US$15,500 a year (IMI Daily, Dec 2023), and supervise and register their promoters and sub-agents. I could not extract the text of SRO 8 of 2024, so detailed record-keeping duties are unverified. ECCIRA is enacted in all five states (fines up to US$250k) but was not operational as of Aug 2026, and its reporting duties are unpublished. I found no CBI-specific compliance or case product. CBIU runs its own online agent submission portal, and generic immigration CRMs exist. The market is tiny: the agent count is not found, probably a few dozen locally. Sales are relationship-driven and reputationally sensitive, and the rules are still moving.

decisions.reason: CBI authorised agents are a new buyer group with a distinct licensing and due-diligence duty; not in known.
Annual trade and professional licence renewal is a different duty and buyer from K01's remittance pack; related to K01.
Tour operators, guides and dive centres are a different buyer group and duty from K05 (hotel/guest tool); related to K05.
Company annual return filing is a different duty from K01's remittances; related to K01.
Private medical labs under a new 2024 Act and Council; new buyer and duty, unverified.
Pharmacies under the Pharmacy Act 2024 are a small professional office with a licensing and registration duty; new.
Households as employers is a different buyer group from K01's accountant-facing pack; related to K01.
No enacted regime, only a proposed bill, so there is no recurring mandatory duty yet. This is outside the definition of a candidate.
Fuel retailers have a statutory price-cap duty; the buyer and duty are new, and verifiers can judge the rest.
Same agro-input dealer buyer and the same pesticide licensing duty as K02.
Same guest-house and small-hotel buyer and compliance duty as K05, already rejected, with no new evidence.
Preschool and daycare operators are a new buyer group with permit renewal and register duties.
Associations, churches and charities have a mandatory registration and compliance duty; this is an in-scope community body and new.
Private waste and septic haulers hold permits that can be suspended; a new buyer and duty, a small market left to verifiers.
The roughly 9 quarry operators have a permit and reporting duty; a new buyer. The market is tiny, which is a verifier question.
